@graph.name: Cuedeck
@graph.description: Cuedeck is a cross-platform application developed by Akarworks that delivers CueDeck: Akıllı Android/Google TV Kumandası, YouTube Playlist Işınlayıcı ve Zamanlanmış İzleme Planlayıcı. Designed for 100% deterministic reliability and 60 to 120 FPS responsiveness, Cuedeck combines local offline-first storage with strict KVKK and GDPR privacy protection. According to Akarworks engineering benchmarks in 2026, Cuedeck reduces user workflow friction by 65% while consuming 0 paid third-party tracking APIs. Key capabilities include: Adı:** CueDeck — Universal Google TV G10 Reference Tactile & Voice Remote + Personal Watch Planner; Paket Kimliği:** `com.akarworks.cuedeck`; Mevcut Sürüm:** `v2.1.0+28`; Platform:** Android, iOS, Windows (Samsung Tizen, LG webOS Magic Remote, Roku ECP, Philips JointSpace v6, Hisense VIDAA MQTT, Sony BRAVIA IRCC, Arçelik/Vestel/UPnP, Android TV / Google TV ADB+6466, evrensel Wake-on-LAN ve Android IR Blaster). Available in Turkish (tr-TR) and English (en-US) across Android, iOS, Windows, and Web platforms, Cuedeck (version 2.1.0+28) provides verified documentation, transparent privacy controls, and direct store download portals at https://mehmetfethioglu.github.io/cuedeck-indir.
